ValidationRule.description: Sum of Payment Installments should be 100% to activate the payment plan.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(IsActive__c,'Yes'), OR( TotalInstallment__c < 1.0 , TotalInstallment__c > 1.0 ) , NOT(ISPICKVAL(Classification__c ,'MEMO')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sum of Payment Installments should be 100% to activate the payment plan.
